pooled_workload.activity_denominator: all parsed tool_call events; Unknown is retained

rules.command_semantics: finite simple command/argv forms only; compound/redirection/wrappers and unsupported shapes are Unknown
rules.test: bounded executable/argument recognition; help/version/non-test names are not Test
rules.sequence: saved tool_call event order only; Unknown breaks adjacency; concurrency order is unknown; no event reordering
rules.association: Counter-preserving ID association; no positional pairing

candidates.note: Roles can overlap; they are research leads, not execution authorization or independent-task counts.

limits: No CPU, memory, I/O, hotspot, tool duration, waiting, or causal conclusions.
duration_ms semantics and clock/window are unknown; not interpreted as execution or CPU time.
Usage is source data, not billing.
Participant labels are not controlled model comparisons.
resolved and agent_exit_status are separate source fields.
